subject: LumenCart MAP: evaluation dataset provisioning & takedown schedule
messages:
From: Amy Carter <amy.carter@lumencart.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Pete Singh <pete.singh@lumencart.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval exchange — quick next steps

Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the low latency on short prompts. We discussed an initial eval window to validate retrieval + generation quality on our commerce prompts. We can share: (1) a small prompt pack (500 prompts, CSV), (2) a labeled judge set (2k items), and (3) an anonymized transaction subset for context.

We have a few constraints from legal/security: no redistribution, no model training, and dataset must be taken down after the trial. Our procurement team suggested a MAP to capture milestones and signoffs. Can Redwood share a proposed MAP + timing and confirm the default constraints (ephemeral access, audit logs, delete after 30 days)?

Amy
Amy Carter
Head of Search & Personalization, LumenCart
amy.carter@lumencart.com
+1 (415) 555-0146

Attachment: none
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Amy Carter <amy.carter@lumencart.com>
Cc: Pete Singh <pete.singh@lumencart.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenCart MAP: evaluation dataset provisioning & takedown schedule

Amy — great to hear the demo landed well. Draft MAP and a short playbook attached; below is a concise timeline we suggest so your team can review quickly. If this looks good we can convert the doc to a signature-ready PDF and route to legal for the single-signature access agreement.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level)
- Apr 5: LumenCart sends promptpack CSV (sample & schema) and judge set metadata; Redwood confirms ingest schema and sandbox path.
- Apr 8: Redwood provides ephemeral S3 presigned bundle + sandbox credentials (read-only, time-limited).
- Apr 9–Apr 16: Redwood runs smoke ingest and provides verification report; LumenCart runs first pass evaluation.
- Apr 17–Apr 24: Joint QA window (testcases run, discrepant examples flagged).
- Apr 25: Quality gate review; decide on extension or close.
- May 6: Full dataset takedown (files removed, audit log snapshot shared).

Usage constraints (defaults we enforce)
- No model training or redistribution.
- Access is ephemeral: credentials expire at takedown.
- All access is logged and we will provide an audit snapshot at takedown.
- Data at rest encrypted under customer-managed KMS key (if requested).

Next steps for you: confirm the Apr 8 ingest window and sign the attached MAP and access agreement. Aditya/ Karthik, PTL please confirm we can commit a sandbox + presigned S3 path for Apr 8 and the audit snapshot on May 6.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (510) 555-0192

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v1.docx (draft)
From: Pete Singh <pete.singh@lumencart.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Carter <amy.carter@lumencart.com>, legal@lumencart.com
Date: Mon, 6 Apr 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenCart MAP: evaluation dataset provisioning & takedown schedule

Marissa — thanks for the clear plan. A couple of legal/security clarifications before we sign:
1) Can Redwood commit to a verified deletion (sha256 tombstone + deletion report) and retention of audit logs for 90 days? Our compliance wants to be able to request logs within 90 days.
2) Can the ephemeral sandbox be IP-restricted to Redwood-managed egress and the RW console team only?
3) We may need a short redline to the MAP around indemnity language — I'll loop legal in.

If we can get (1) deletion report and (2) IP/effectively-limited egress, we'll move quickly. Also, do you require a PO before we sign the access agreement?

Pete
Pete Singh
Senior PM, LumenCart
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Pete Singh <pete.singh@lumencart.com>, Amy Carter <amy.carter@lumencart.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, legal@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenCart MAP: evaluation dataset provisioning & takedown schedule

Pete — thanks for the questions. Quick answers and commitments below:
- Deletion & audit: Redwood will produce a verified deletion report (SHA256 checksums of files removed) and a time-stamped audit snapshot. We retain audit logs for 180 days by default for enterprise MAPs; we can commit to 90 days if required.
- Network controls: we can restrict the sandbox to a set of egress eips and enforce console-only access via our private link when using Redwood Private. For the hosted sandbox we will apply IP restrictions and scope credentials to minimal permissions. Karthik — we'll need the exact CIDR list from LumenCart to apply ACLs.
- PO: No PO required to start the evaluation; we only need the signed access agreement for the dataset exchange.

I attached a lightly redlined access agreement (lumencart_promptpack_v1.zip includes the sample prompt pack and metadata; mutual_action_plan_v1.docx updated with the takedown language). If legal has formal redlines, please send them back and we'll route to our legal for a fast turnaround.

Aditya, Karthik — confirm timeline and that the Apr 8 provision is feasible.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments referenced: lumencart_promptpack_v1.zip (prompt pack + metadata), mutual_action_plan_v1.docx (updated)
From: Amy Carter <amy.carter@lumencart.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Pete Singh <pete.singh@lumencart.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenCart MAP: evaluation dataset provisioning & takedown schedule

Marissa — this all looks good. Legal will send a 1-page redline (mostly indemnity tweak) by morning. We can confirm Apr 8 as long as we get the presigned location and credentials by EOD Apr 7. Also confirming we don't need a PO to begin.

We expect to:
- Send signed access agreement (single signature) by Apr 7 EOD.
- Provide CIDR list to Karthik by Apr 7 for IP lockdown.
- Run evaluation and share first-pass results during Apr 9–16 window.

Amy

Attachment: Lumen_Access_Agreement_Signature.pdf (scanned signature)
